title: GrowerHub — more time for the plants you love
description: Lighting schedules for a plant shelf or small nursery. Ready-to-order kits, CDEK delivery and help getting connected. Try GrowerHub without any hardware.

demo.title: You can start without any hardware
demo.text: Open a ready-made demo farm: explore the plants, try a lighting schedule and get to know the app at your own pace.
demo.note: Everything in the demo is virtual. Your actions cannot switch someone else's plug.

connection_note: Controlling devices requires home Wi-Fi with an internet connection.

faq.title: A little reassurance before you start

items.question: I am not technical. Will I manage?
items.answer: We will help you choose and check your kit. At home, plug it in, connect the hub to your Wi-Fi using the Upravlyator app and link it to GrowerHub. A step-by-step guide and help with the first connection are included.

items.question: What happens after I place an order?
items.answer: We will contact you, confirm the kit and delivery, and check the devices before shipping. There is nothing to pay on the website at this stage. Enter the code and address of your chosen CDEK pickup point yourself.

items.question: Do I need to buy hardware straight away?
items.answer: No. Open the demo farm without signing up to explore the app and change settings on virtual devices. You can choose your hardware whenever you are ready.

items.question: What can a kit do, and does it need the internet?
items.answer: These kits control lighting schedules through smart plugs. GrowerHub and the PushOk cloud need internet access. Lamps are supplied separately; these kits are not intended for automated watering.
